findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "buscalc_commercial_lease_economics" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Calculate net effective rent, CAM reconciliation, a contract-specific yield maintenance estimate, initial balances for a fixed operating lease, or a single inve…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
